pr_title: ADR0133: complete Remote AI Studio first-release validation
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR0133 Remote AI Studio actual-browser validation and fixes the browser helper lifetime discovered by exact-head visual review. The Remote helper now uses an explicit ADR0133 visual scenario, is excluded from native screenshot auto-close, normalizes blank screenshot paths, and continues isolating inherited visual environment.

## Validation

Requires full Windows Validation because `scripts/ci/**` changes, Automation Regression, and ChatGPT visual review of the production Remote AI Studio screenshots.
